build_GPT_model: build a GPT language model using GPTConfig with vocab_size, block_size, n_layer, n_head, and n_embd parameters
create_GPTConfig: create a GPTConfig dataclass to configure vocab_size, block_size, n_layer, n_head, and n_embd for the GPT model
test_EmbeddingStem: test the EmbeddingStem class forward pass with token indices and verify positional embeddings are applied
refactor_MultiheadAttentionLayer: refactor the MultiheadAttentionLayer to adjust the causal attention mask or change the number of attention heads
review_Block: review the Block transformer class combining LayerNorm, MultiheadAttentionLayer, and an MLP with GELU activation
